components.name: Primary Cobalt Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #1d4ed8; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1e40af; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Isolated Destructive Button
components.description: Separated crimson action for Tolak, Hapus, or Akhiri Triwulan.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fef2f2; color: #b91c1c; border: 1px solid #fecaca; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #b91c1c; color: #ffffff; border-color: #b91c1c; }

narrative.overview: University Senate Folio treats faculty KPI governance like an authoritative academic ledger rather than generic SaaS card-soup. A deep slate-indigo rail anchors persistent navigation across Renstra and PTN-BH tracks while wide, sunlit archival-stone workspaces hold crisp white data sheets divided by clean 1px hairlines.
keyCharacteristics: Anchored 248px slate-indigo left rail paired with warm archival stone ground (#f6f5f1).
Persistent Quarterly Rollover Ribbon surfacing active year (tahun) and Triwulan 1–4 progression beneath the sticky bar.
Strict tabular numeral alignment (JetBrains Mono + tabular-nums) for KPI codes, target totals, and department scores.
Spatial isolation for destructive actions (Tolak, Hapus) separated from constructive actions (Simpan, Setujui).

rules.name: The Isolated Destructive Rule
rules.body: Destructive actions (Tolak, Hapus, Akhiri Triwulan) use semantic crimson styling and must be spatially separated from constructive primary cobalt buttons so operators never confirm an irreversible governance action by habit.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: KPI sheets and summary tiles rest flat on the archival stone ground with 1px borders; depth comes from surface contrast and clean whitespace, never decorative shadows or colored side-stripes.

dos: Do render KPI codes, target totals, and triwulan numbers with tabular-nums (JetBrains Mono for codes).
Do keep Tolak, Hapus, and quarter rollover buttons visually isolated and confirmed intentionally.
donts: Don't place university-specific external hotlinks, logos, or text in faculty branding; keep neutral SI-IKU Fakultas identity.
Don't add small spaced-uppercase eyebrow kickers above section titles or colored 4px left stripes on rounded cards.
